messages:
maggie_sec: Heads-up — Acme reported failure when promoting from staging -> prod, our deploy shows a 403 on wrapKey to their Azure Key Vault.
ashwin_support: Which exact 403? can you paste the error snippet? @ivan_infra FYI.
emma_cust: Here is the error they pasted: `Failed to encrypt envelope: AccessDenied: The client does not have permission to perform this operation. (Code: Forbidden)`. They say staging uses same SP and works.
maggie_sec: Common root causes: role assignment propagation delay, scope mismatch (sub vs resource group), or vault RBAC vs access policies mismatch. Ask them for `az role assignment list --assignee <sp-id>` and `az keyvault show --name <vault>` output.
ivan_infra: Quick triage commands to ask for (paste verbatim):
```
az role assignment list --assignee <SP_OBJECT_ID> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
az keyvault show --name <vault-name>
az keyvault show --name <vault-name> --query properties.enableRbacAuthorization
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/<alias>    # if AWS
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy <key> --location <loc>  # if GCP
```
ashwin_support: Note: if Azure Key Vault is RBAC-enabled the SP needs a role with crypto permissions (not just Reader). If it's using Key Vault access policies, the policy must include `wrapKey`/`encrypt` permissions.
emma_cust: Customer ran `az keyvault show`: `properties.enableRbacAuthorization: true`. They also showed a role assignment for the SP but roleDefinitionName = "Reader".
maggie_sec: There’s your problem. Reader cannot call wrap/encrypt. Suggest `Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User` or a custom role containing `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/deploy/action` + crypto actions. Example custom role (ask them to create):
```
{
  "Name": "KV-WrapKey-User",
  "IsCustom": true,
  "Actions": [
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/decrypt/action",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/encrypt/action",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/wrapKey/action",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/unwrapKey/action"
  ],
  "NotActions": [],
  "AssignableScopes": ["/subscriptions/<sub>"]
}
```
ivan_infra: Also tell them to check Key Vault diagnostic logs (Azure Monitor -> Diagnostic settings -> send to Log Analytics) for `AuditEvent` entries where `operationName` contains `WrapKey` to confirm permission failures. In our platform logs look for error id `err:KV_WRAP_403` and include the request id.
deploy-bot: Notice: prod deploy for acme-prod (run 202) failed, automatic fallback to staging completed.
ashwin_support: Next steps for customer: 1) Assign correct role (or update access policy) 2) Wait ~10-15m for RBAC propagation 3) Retry deploy and paste `az keyvault key show --vault-name <vault> --name <key> --query attributes` and any new error ids.
maggie_sec: Also double-check that the SP object id matches the identity we have in the deploy manifest — common mistake when customers have multiple SPs.
emma_cust: I'll message them with the commands + the role JSON and request logs. Will update here when they respond. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread: customer onboarding KMS RBAC troubleshooting; content is short messages, includes code snippets, bot notice. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
